soundness_flags.label: ass:strong-gram and def:model-class
soundness_flags.one_line: The model-class condition invokes H as if it were a finite-array primitive, but H is defined only along an unspecified limiting subsequence; introduce H_ell and impose its uniform lower bound before taking subsequential limits.

soundness_flags.label: ass:stable-quantile-span and target_estimand
soundness_flags.one_line: “Every untreated period” is not indexed to include the treated unit’s post-period no-intervention law, yet post-period Q^N_0t is required to identify tau; state the span restriction for Q^N_0t for every panel period.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The summary states that counterfactuals are identified by matching treated pre-intervention quantile residuals with a convex combination of potential-control residuals, with orthogonality to observable common factors.

source_verification_receipts.version: Econometrica 91(3), 2023; repository record for published article
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The record verifies the cited Econometrica article, volume, issue, and pages; the version-of-record Proposition 5 display was not inspectable here, so no formula-level comparison was made.
The paper uses empirical quantiles, a lower density condition, and donor-weight dilution; Corollary 3 gives conditional Gaussian-approximation conditions in that setting.
Theorem 2 assumes an interior optimal DSC weight and gives a weight-convergence bound involving fit errors, within-unit sample size, and donor count.

source_verification_receipts.version: author manuscript corresponding to the JASA article
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Theorem 2 converts jointly valid distribution-function bands into simultaneous quantile-function and quantile-effect bands by inversion and Minkowski difference.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Replace H in the class definition by the finite-array Gram H_ell, impose v' H_ell v >= lambda ||v||^2 uniformly, and define H only as a subsequential limit of H_ell.

State explicitly that the stable quantile-span restriction holds for the treated unit’s no-intervention potential law in all post-treatment periods, then add the known-weights and point-mass sanity reductions immediately after it.

Obtain and cite the exact version-of-record Proposition 5 display in Gunsilius, then give a formula-level comparison showing precisely which endpoint-noise and estimated-weight terms are absent or different.

Make the raw-to-local-Gaussian transfer theorem the next formal focal target: specify a uniform coupling and anti-concentration route sufficient to transfer conditional cutoff coverage through support and face changes.

recommended_next_step: Revise the two model-defining coherence defects, then advance the corrected field-tier kernel to Stage 0 with a source-verified Gunsilius comparison.
